dark.commentary:
Lumina Dawn, dark variant.
Warm sepia ground; aged-ivory text and deep hand-mixed inks of red, ochre, blue and violet under lamplight.

light.commentary:
Lumina Dawn, light variant.
Aged-ivory paper with deep hand-mixed inks of red, ochre, blue and violet.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Oxblood, dark variant.
A theatre after the curtain falls: oxblood-velvet drape in shadow, a single overhead spot on the gilt frame. Brass and wine in cascade, sage relief, cream-parchment strings.

light.commentary:
Lumina Oxblood, light variant.
Warm wine-tinted paper; deep gilt-ink lead, velvet-wine in cascade, sage relief.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Ember, dark variant.
A blacksmith's shop at night: cold dark iron in shadow, the incandescent forge-glow at the heart of the metal. Hot-iron and embers in cascade, cold anvil-blue, linen-apron strings.

light.commentary:
Lumina Ember, light variant.
Workshop paper in daylight; deep forge-glow ink, hot-iron and ember inks, cold anvil-blue ink.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Tide, dark variant.
Deep ocean at night, lit from within by a bioluminescent jellyfish: ocean teal and surface cyan in cascade, biolum violet, muted coral and sand as rare warm notes.

light.commentary:
Lumina Tide, light variant.
Cool teal paper; deep biolum-green ink, ocean teal and surface cyan in cascade, biolum violet.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Indigo, dark variant.
An indigo dyer's workshop at dusk: the deep dye-vat at the centre, copper kettles in lamp-glow, verdigris on aged tools. Aged drying-cloth for strings.

light.commentary:
Lumina Indigo, light variant.
Cool indigo-tinted paper; deep indigo-dye ink as lead, copper-warm and verdigris-cool inks.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Canopy, dark variant.
A pine forest at noon: a single shaft of sun pierces the canopy. Autumn russet and amber in the lit leaves, chlorophyll and pine in shadow, moss-bark strings.

light.commentary:
Lumina Canopy, light variant.
Green-tinted paper; deep sun-shaft gold ink, autumn russet and amber inks, chlorophyll and pine inks.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Slate, dark variant.
Cold graphite ground; near-achromatic palette with one steel-blue voice for emphasis.

light.commentary:
Lumina Slate, light variant.
Cool stone-grey paper; near-achromatic inks with one deep steel-blue voice for emphasis.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Aurora, dark variant.
Icelandic basalt night swept by the aurora borealis: emerald-green glow, magnetic violet, glacial cyan. A distant campfire amber on the black beach.

light.commentary:
Lumina Aurora, light variant.
Cool stone paper; deep emerald, magnetic-violet and glacial-cyan inks. A distant campfire amber for the warm contrast.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Solitude, dark variant.
A mountain observatory at midnight: cool slate ground, one deep teal beacon governing the surface. A warm campfire amber as the only counterpoint.

light.commentary:
Lumina Solitude, light variant.
Glacier-white paper, stone-cream typography, one deep petrol-teal governing the page. A single quiet amber for the warm.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Monastery, dark variant.
An old scriptorium: aged-leather shadows, dark stone, the sacred glow of beeswax gold. Cuir and brass in cascade, sage relief for strings, rust red for alarms.

light.commentary:
Lumina Monastery, light variant.
Warm parchment paper; beeswax-gold ink burned into the page, leather and brass in cascade, sage strings.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Jade, dark variant.
Volcanic glass and jade: obsidian ground, jade-green as the single guide, oxidized copper-jade and stone-grey in cascade. Vert-de-gris for strings.

light.commentary:
Lumina Jade, light variant.
Cool stone paper; deep jade-green ink, oxidized copper-jade and stone-grey in cascade.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Cherenkov, dark variant.
Nuclear reactor cooling pool at night: deep ink-water ground, the electric blue-violet Cherenkov glow as the single source. Cobalt and iridescent green-cyan in cascade.

light.commentary:
Lumina Cherenkov, light variant.
Cool ice-paper; deep Cherenkov-cyan ink, cobalt-violet and iridescent green-cyan in cascade.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Vesper, dark variant.
The evening star piercing dusk: cool velvet-violet sky, a single warm cream of Venus governing the surface. Twilight purple and silver-velvet in support.

light.commentary:
Lumina Vesper, light variant.
Pre-dawn parchment slightly warmed; star-warm ink as lead, twilight-purple velvet inks in cascade.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Eclipse, dark variant.
A total eclipse: violet-graphite blackness against the pure solar corona of gold. Storm-blue totality sky and eruption-red prominences as the contrast voices.

light.commentary:
Lumina Eclipse, light variant.
Pale stone paper of strange dimmed daylight; deep solar-gold inks, storm-blue and eruption-red contrast inks.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Petrichor, dark variant.
The earth after a storm: wet-slate ground, terracotta clay, sage of regrown moss, ochre of dried earth, mist-blue of the cleared air.

light.commentary:
Lumina Petrichor, light variant.
Warm rain-damp parchment; terracotta as lead, sage and ochre in cascade, mist-blue strings.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Atelier, dark variant.
A modernist designer's workshop at dusk: polished concrete floor, one brushed-brass lamp on the workbench, navy wool cushion, linen canvas.

light.commentary:
Lumina Atelier, light variant.
Warm linen-cream paper; brass-burned ink as lead, navy ink for the cool counterpoint, sage-linen strings.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Cinnabar, dark variant.
Chinese imperial lacquer-work: warm ink-black ground, cinnabar red (mercury sulfide, eight thousand years of Asian decorative art). Gold-leaf and imperial jade in cascade.

light.commentary:
Lumina Cinnabar, light variant.
Warm rice paper; cinnabar ink as lead, gold-leaf and imperial-jade inks in cascade.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Prisma, dark variant.
A single white light enters a glass prism in a darkened optical chamber and refracts: violet, cerulean, mint, peach. One source, many outputs.

light.commentary:
Lumina Prisma, light variant.
Cool slate paper; deep spectral inks — violet as lead, cerulean, mint and peach in cascade.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Tyrian, dark variant.
A Phoenician dyer's workshop on the Mediterranean coast at dusk: imperial murex purple, gold workshop-lamps, the sea outside, olive groves for strings.

light.commentary:
Lumina Tyrian, light variant.
Warm parchment; deep Tyrian ink burned into the page, gold-leaf, Mediterranean-sea and olive-grove inks.

dark.commentary:
Lumina Lapis, dark variant.
A Renaissance pigment-grinder's workshop: rough lapis-lazuli from the Sar-e-Sang mines, agate mortar, marble pestle. The precious pigment more costly than gold.

light.commentary:
Lumina Lapis, light variant.
Cool stone paper; deep ultramarine ink as lead, cobalt and azurite in cascade, gold-leaf ink for the warm.
